title: TKI Diatom NGS Protocol
author: Kevin Beentjes
materials: DNA extraction is done using the DNeasy PowerSoil Pro Kit (Qiagen catalogue number 47016). For the ethanol sampling , containing diatoms that are easily released from the substrate: Shake the jar containing the reed stems vigorously for 30 seconds to homogenize the sample. Remove 2 mL of the mixture into a 2.0 mL eppendorf tube. Spin down the tube briefly (1 minute at maximum speed) to collect the diatoms in a pellet at the bottom of the tube. Pour off the ethanol, air dry briefly and resuspend the pellet in 800 µL of Solution CD1 from the PowerSoil Pro Kit.

Amplification for metabarcoding on Illumina NovaSeq is performed using a two-step PCR. The first PCR is used to amplify the rbcL marker region that matches the reference sequences captured in the online Diat.barcode database ( https://entrepot.recherche.data.gouv.fr/dataset.xhtml?persistentId=doi:10.15454/TOMBYZ ) (Rimet et al., 2019). Primers rbcL_708F (Stoof-Leichsenring et al., 2012) & rbcL_R3 (Bruder and Medlin, 2007) are used with IDT10 adapters for Illumina sequencing. IDT_rbcL_708F: CACTCTTTCCCTACACGACGCTCTTCCGATCT AGGTGAAGTTAAAGGTTCATACTTDAA IDT_rbcL_R3: GTGACTGGAGTTCAGACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATCT CCTTCTAATTTACCAACAACTG PCR mix (20 µL reaction): 10.4 µL mQ water 4.0 µL Thermo Fisher Phire Green 5x PCR buffer 0.8 µL BSA (10 mg/mL) 1.0 µL primer IDT_rbcL_708F (10 µM) 1.0 µL primer IDT_rbcL_R3 (10 µM) 0.4 µL dNTPs (2.5 mM) 0.4 µL Thermo Fisher Phire II HS Taq 2.0 µL template DNA (undiluted) PCR program : Initial denature: 30s at 98°C Followed by 30 cycles of 5s at 98°C, 5s at 50°C, and 15s at 72°C Followed by final extension of 5 minutes at 72°C

The second PCR is used to attach IDT10 indices for Illumina NovaSeq sequencing. IDT_i5: AATGATACGGCGACCACCGAGATCTACAC [i5] ACACTCTTTCCCTACACGACGCTCTTCCGATC*T IDT_i7: CAAGCAGAAGACGGCATACGAGAT [i7] GTGACTGGAGTTCAGACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATC*T PCR mix (20 µL reaction): 11.2 µL mQ water 4.0 µL Thermo Fisher Phire Green 5x PCR buffer 1.0 µL forward primer (10 µM) 1.0 µL reverse primer (10 µM) 0.4 µL dNTPs (2.5 mM) 0.4 µL Thermo Fisher Phire II HS Taq 2.0 µL cleaned template DNA from step 6 (undiluted) PCR program : Initial denature: 30s at 98°C Followed by 5 cycles of 5s at 98°C, 5s at 55°C, and 15s at 72°C Followed by final extension of 5 minutes at 72°C

steps.title: Collect Diatom Samples
steps.instruction: Collect samples from the selected location for DNA and optional morphological analysis.

substeps.instruction: Select approximately 5 to 10 reed stems and cut them at a depth of 15 to 20 cm below the water surface. If no reeds are present, collect other water plants or scrape hard substrate in contact with open water.
Collect samples for DNA analysis in 96% ethanol using individually labeled jars or 50ml falcon tubes.

steps.title: Perform Substrate Sampling
steps.instruction: Extract diatoms not easily released from the substrate.

substeps.instruction: Scrape 3 to 5 reed stems along the full length with a scalpel.
Add scraped material to the tube containing Solution CD1 and the pellet from step 2, or add to a new tube containing 800 µL of Solution CD1 from the PowerSoil Pro Kit.

steps.title: Extract DNA
steps.instruction: Continue DNA extraction following the manufacturer's kit protocol.

substeps.instruction: Use 100 µL of Solution C6 for the final elution step.

steps.title: Verify and Clean PCR Products
steps.instruction: Check PCR success and clean products using magnetic beads before the second PCR labeling.

substeps.instruction: Check PCR success on a 2% agarose gel (e.g., E-Gel 96 Agarose Gels, Thermo Scientific G720802).
Clean products using a 0.9 ratio of magnetic beads (e.g., Nucleomag NGS clean-up and size select, Macherey-Nagel 744970.50) manually or automatically.
If using a magnetic separation rack: Bring beads to room temperature and vortex.
Prepare fresh 80% ethanol (200 µL per sample).
Add 0.9 x PCR product volume of beads to wells of a clean 96-well plate.
Add PCR product to MN beads, mix by pipetting, and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place plate on magnetic rack for 5 minutes; remove supernatant once clear.
Wash beads twice with 100 µL 80% ethanol while keeping the plate on the magnet.
Air dry beads for 1 minute on the magnet.
Resuspend beads with 20 µL mQ water and place back on the rack for 5 minutes.
Transfer 18 µL of the supernatant to a clean plate.

steps.title: Measure and Pool Amplicons
steps.instruction: Quantify amplicon concentrations and create equimolar pools.

substeps.instruction: Measure concentrations using Agilent Fragment Analyzer with NF-910 dsDNA Reagent Kit (35-1500 bp), followed by smear analysis using PROSize 3.0 software (range 350 bp to 550 bp).
Pool each plate of samples equimolarly into a 1.5 mL lowbind eppendorf tube (manually or via Qiagen QIAgility/Opentrons OT-2), including blanks.

Ensure the lowest and highest concentrations differ by no more than a factor of five by: (1) pooling low/high concentrations separately, (2) diluting high concentrations, or (3) treating very low concentrations as 1/5th of the highest.

steps.title: Create and Clean End-Pool
steps.instruction: Combine plate pools into a single end-pool and perform final cleaning.

substeps.instruction: Measure the concentration of each plate pool using Agilent TapeStation with High Sensitivity D5000 ScreenTape Assay.
Combine pools equimolarly into a single end-pool.
Clean the end-pool using a 0.9 ratio of magnetic beads (e.g., Nucleomag NGS clean-up and size select, Macherey-Nagel 744970.50).
Save a portion of the non-cleaned pool (e.g., 100µl).
Bring beads to room temperature, vortex, and prepare fresh 80% ethanol (200 µL per sample).
Add 0.9 x pool volume of MN beads to the pool and vortex.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, then place on magnetic rack for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant once clear.
Wash beads twice with 500 µL 80% ethanol on the magnet.
Air dry beads for 1 minute on the magnet.
Resuspend beads with 50-200 µL mQ water and place on rack for 5 minutes.
Transfer supernatant to a clean 1.5 mL lowbind eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Sequence Samples
steps.instruction: Perform sequencing on the Illumina NovaSeq platform in a PE250 run.

steps.title: Process Sequencing Data
steps.instruction: Process demultiplexed NovaSeq data into ESVs using the APSCALE pipeline.

substeps.instruction: PE merging: maxdiffpct = 25, maxdiffs = 100, minovlen = 30
Primer trimming: p5 = AGGTGAAGTTAAAGGTTCATACTTDAA, p7 = CCTTCTAATTTACCAACAACTG, anchoring = false
Quality filtering: maxEE = 1, min length = 262, max length = 270
Dereplication pooling: min size to pool = 8
Denoising: alpha = 2, minsize = 8, to excel = true
Lulu filtering: minimum similarity = 84, minimum relative cooccurence = 95, minimum ratio = 1, to excel = true

steps.title: Identify ESVs
steps.instruction: Identify ESVs using BLAST and Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA) analysis.

substeps.instruction: Perform BLAST search against the Diat.barcode database (using Galaxy environment/custom script).
For ESVs without species-level matches, perform LCA analysis.
BLAST settings: query coverage cutoff = 85, identify % cutoff = 85, maximum number of hits = 100

LCA settings: top bitscore % cutoff = 5, minimum bitscore = 170, minimum identity = 85, minimum coverage = 100, settings mode = output top hit as species identification if above threshold, identity threshold = 98, query coverage threshold = 100
